'''Tim Guzman''' was a Las Vegas tournament director and a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], Gold 117.<ref name="decsq-prof" /><ref name="sm-fan" />

He began directing after playing in events run by Chris Hines (Gold 8), and joined the squadron on Hines's recommendation.<ref name="decsq-prof" />

== In their own words ==

<blockquote>
Next thing you know I go to my first Tournament directed by Chris Hines, Gold 8. From that time I have always been a part of the tournament scene.

As a Squadron member I look forward to bringing in even more new players. Not only for SW:CCG but also YJ:CCG. Both are just the greatest games.<ref name="decsq-prof" />
</blockquote>
